Error.description: Something went wrong. `error` is a stable code (`unauthorized`, `not_found`, `conflict`, `name_taken`, `quota_exceeded`, `rate_limited`, `transfer_limit`...), `message` is for people.

ActivityEvent.description:
Something someone did in a folder. Names aren't here: the client finds
and decrypts the node's, if it can still reach it.

kind.description: added, changed (a new version), renamed, moved, trashed or restored.

AdminAlerts.description:
`GET /api/admin/alerts`: what an admin should look at. Plain counts,
like the stats.

near_quota.description: Accounts (not disabled) using at least 90% of their quota, fullest first.

spaces.description:
The data directory's disk, the blob directory's if it's another one,
and the bucket when the server was told its capacity.

default_quota.description: Quota for new accounts (from the server's configuration).

downloader_can_merge.description:
Whether ffmpeg is installed, so video and audio can be merged
(needed for most YouTube videos).

downloader_max_bytes.description: Largest download passed through, in bytes.

google_drive.description:
Whether people may link a new Google Drive: None when the server has
no Google app set up. Drives already linked keep working either way.

yt_dlp_version.description: yt-dlp's version, or None if it isn't installed on the server.

daily_download_limit.description:
Daily transfer limits in bytes (None: no limit), and what was moved
today (UTC).

last_seen.description: Most recent activity of any of their sessions.

oneOf.description:
The file's content key re-wrapped under the new node key, so the
key the visitor chose stops mattering. Requires `enc_metadata`.

enc_key.description: The node key wrapped under the folder's key.

oneOf.description:
The metadata under the new key (with a new name, if the dropped one
is taken), and the name tag.

AuditEntry.description:
One admin action (see the server's audit.rs). `target` is the account
it was about, `detail` the new value where there is one (bytes, a mode,
days), both as they were at the time.

AuditPage.description: Newest first; `more` when there are older ones (ask with `?before=<last id>`).

AuthOptions.description: What the sign-in screen needs to know before anyone is signed in.

admin_username.description: ...and must have this username, when set.

setup.description: The first account on this new server needs the setup code.

oneOf.description: Set when this server asks for a Cloudflare Turnstile check.

sealed_key.description: The avatar key sealed to the grantee (see `seal_avatar_key`).

ChangeFeed.description: One page of the change feed (`GET /api/changes?since=<cursor>`).

changes.description:
Nodes that changed after the cursor, oldest first. A node may appear
more than once. Only ids: fetch the node to see what it is now (a 404
means it's gone, or no longer yours to see).

cursor.description: Where to continue from next time.

more.description: More changes wait: ask again with `cursor` straight away.

resync.description:
The cursor is older than the history kept: walk the whole tree again,
then carry on from `cursor`.

author.description: The author's username. Comments go when their author's account does.

created_at.description: To the hour; the exact time is inside the encrypted body.

auth_key.description: The auth half of the app password (see `derive_app_password_keys`).

enc_master_key.description: The master key wrapped under the app password's KEK.

id.description: Chosen by the client: it's bound into `enc_body`.

oneOf.description: `name_tag(parent key, name)`: lets the server refuse a duplicate name.

days.description: How long the invite stays valid, in days (1 to 90).

oneOf.description:
With a password (except upload-only links): the node key wrapped
under the link's KEK (`wrap_link_key`), handed to visitors who give
the password, and the link's secret under the node key
(`encrypt_link_secret`) so the owner can show the link again.

max_opens.description:
Stop working after this many opens (1: after the first). An open is
a visit to the link page; the visit itself can then fetch everything.

oneOf.description:
For a link with a password: the auth key from
`derive_link_password_keys`. The password itself never reaches the
server.

upload_only.description:
A file drop: visitors can add files to the folder but see nothing
in it. The link carries the owner's public key after `#` instead of
the folder key.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds; the share ends then.

wrapped_key.description: Node key sealed to the recipient's public key.

oneOf.description: Required for a new file.

if_revision.description: For new versions: fail with 409 if the node changed meanwhile.

oneOf.description: For a new file: its name tag (see `name_tag`).

node_id.description:
Client-chosen id of the new node, or the id of an existing file
node when uploading a new version.

parent_id.description: Set for a new file: the folder to create it in.

CreatedInvite.description: A new invite. `token` is shown once; the server keeps only its hash.

DeleteAccountRequest.description: Delete your own account, proving the password again.

DeviceSession.description: A signed-in device, as listed in Settings. No IP addresses are kept.

app_password.description: Name of the app password it signed in with, if any.

method.description:
How it signed in: `password`, `password+code`, `password+passkey`,
`passkey`, `recovery`, `register` or `app_password`. None for
sessions from before the server recorded it.

DownloaderAccess.description:
Who may use the video downloader, the one tool where the server sees
what it handles (see MILESTONES.md). Off by default.

Draft.description:
Unsaved edits to a text file, encrypted under the editor's master key
(see `encrypt_private_data`, labelled with the node id).

base_revision.description: The file's revision the draft started from.

DroppedFile.description:
A file added through an upload-only link, waiting for the folder owner
to open its sealed key and wrap it under the folder key.

sealed_key.description: The node key sealed to the owner's public key (see `seal_drop_key`).

enc_metadata.description: Metadata the version was uploaded with (plaintext size, mtime).

pinned.description:
Kept out of the per-file limit, thinning and pruning for space.
Missing from older servers, so it defaults to false.

FinishUploadRequest.description:
Optional body for finishing an upload of a new file: a new name (and
its tag) if the one it started with was taken meanwhile.

KdfParams.description:
Argon2id cost parameters. Stored (in the clear) by the server so the
client can re-derive keys on login.

KeyBundle.description: Encrypted key material the client needs after login.

oneOf.description: Absent for accounts made before post-quantum keys.
For a link with a password: its secret, sealed under the node key.

LinkStorageResponse.description: Where to send the browser to approve access.

turnstile.description: A Turnstile token, when the server asks for one.

LoginResponse.description:
What signing in with a password returns: a session, or, when the account
has two-factor sign-in, a ticket to finish it with a second factor.

max_versions.description: Versions kept per file, including the current one.

recovery_created_at.description: When a recovery key was set up, if there is one.

totp_created_at.description: When an authenticator app (TOTP) was set up, if there is one.

trash_days.description: Days before trashed items are purged.

MoveNodeStorageRequest.description:
`POST /api/nodes/{id}/storage` (owner only): move a batch of the file's
(or folder's) versions to this server (`to: null`) or into an
extra-space account. Answered with a `MoveStorageResponse`; call again
while `left` is above zero.

MoveStorageRequest.description:
`POST /api/storage/accounts/{id}/move`: move a batch of file versions
between this server and a linked account (`Linked` only for extra space).
Call again while `left` is above zero.

full.description:
Some versions didn't fit at the destination, so they stay where
they are.

left.description: Versions still to move, and their bytes.

moved.description: Versions moved by this call, and their bytes.

grantees.description: Who has been given the avatar key.

NameTags.description: Name tags for existing children that don't have one yet.

enc_key.description: Root folder key wrapped under the master key.

This node's key, wrapped under the parent's key (or the master key
for a root folder).

name_tagged.description: Whether the node has a name tag (older ones may not).

trash_at.description: When it goes to the trash on its own, if its owner set a date.

NodePage.description:
A page of a folder's children (`GET .../children?limit=<n>&after=<cursor>`);
without `limit` the listing is the whole array instead.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; `None` on the last one.

NodePath.description:
The chain of nodes from the top-most node the caller can access down to
the requested node. For the owner this starts at their root folder. For
a share recipient it starts at the shared node, and `share` carries the
key wrapped for them.

account_id.description: The linked account, or None for this server.

NodeStorage.description:
`GET /api/nodes/{id}/storage` (owner only): where a file's versions, or
those of every file in a folder, are kept.

unlock.description: It can unlock the account on its own (PRF), not just confirm a sign-in.

PasskeyAssertion.description: A WebAuthn assertion, as the browser returns it.

PasskeyCreationOptions.description: What `navigator.credentials.create` needs to make a passkey.

PasskeyLoginRequest.description:
Sign in with a passkey alone. The challenge comes from
`/api/auth/passkey/options`.

enc_master_key.description: Unwrapped with the key from the passkey's PRF output.

allow_credentials.description: The account's credentials (empty for a sign-in with a passkey alone).

oneOf.description: None until the client first saves something.

For a link with a password, once it's given: the node key wrapped
under the link's KEK, which needs the password and the secret after
`#` to open.

link_token.description:
For a link with a limited number of opens: this visit's token, to
pass back in the `X-Link-Token` header.

oneOf.description: Absent for upload-only links.

owner.description:
Who files dropped through an upload-only link go to, and the folder
id to bind into their sealed keys.

oneOf.description:
The owner's ML-KEM key, for upload-only links whose `#` part names
its hash. Checked against it, so the server can't swap it.

if_revision.description: The revision this change is based on; 409 if it moved on.

RecoveryResetRequest.description: Step two: a new password, with the master key re-wrapped under it.

RecoveryUnlockRequest.description:
Step one of a password reset: prove the recovery key, get the master key
wrapped under it.

oneOf.description:
The master key wrapped under a key from the passkey's PRF output (see
`wrap_master_key_passkey`), when the authenticator supports PRF.

invite.description: Invite token, needed when registration is invite-only.

oneOf.description: The ML-KEM-768 public key and its seed wrapped under the master key.

setup_code.description: The setup code, for the first account on a new server.

turnstile.description: A Turnstile token, when the server asks for one.

ResealShareRequest.description:
A share's node key sealed again by its recipient, to their own
X25519 + ML-KEM-768 key (for shares made before they had one).

oneOf.description: A new name (when the old one is taken) and its tag.

parent_id.description:
Restore into a different folder (e.g. when the original one is gone).
Requires `enc_key` re-wrapped under that folder's key.

enc_metadata.description:
The node's metadata re-encrypted for the restored version (current
name, the version's size and mtime).

oneOf.description: Set when the account has passkeys.

ticket.description: Pass back with the second factor. Valid for a few minutes.

totp.description: An authenticator app code is accepted.

SecondFactorRequest.description: Finish a password sign-in with a TOTP code or a passkey.

ServerStats.description: Counts only; nothing about what is stored.

oneOf.description: The picture, encrypted under the avatar key.
Pronouns and grammatical gender, under the same key (`encrypt_person_details`).

enc_key.description: The avatar key, encrypted under the master key.

oneOf.description: The display name, encrypted under the same key (`encrypt_display_name`).

SetPqKeyRequest.description: Give an older account its post-quantum key. Only once.

SetRecoveryRequest.description: Set up (or replace) a recovery key. Needs the current password.

SetTrashAtRequest.description:
`PUT /api/nodes/{id}/trash-at`: a date (Unix seconds) for the node to go
to the trash on its own, or none. The server learns the date, not the name.

broken.description: The provider stopped accepting the token: link it again.

free_bytes.description: Free space there when last asked; None for no limit or not known yet.

label.description: The account's address, to tell accounts apart.

mirror_total.description:
For a mirror: bytes this server keeps that it should have, and how
many of those it has.

only_there.description:
Bytes of file versions kept only there (none in a mirror until it
was switched from extra space). These come back here before the
account can be unlinked.

google.description: Whether this server can link Google Drive.

server_used.description: Bytes kept on this server, and its quota (as in `Me`).

StorageMode.description: What a linked storage account is for.

low.description: Nearly full: under a tenth free (or, for a disk, under 2 GiB).

ToolsInfo.description: Which tools this user can use.

downloader_can_merge.description:
Whether separate video and audio can be merged (up to 1080p), or only
formats offered as one file work.

TotpSetup.description: A new TOTP secret, waiting to be confirmed with a code from the app.

secret.description: Base32, as authenticator apps take it.

TransferInfo.description: The caller's own daily transfer limits and use (`GET /api/me/transfer`).

resets_at.description: When today's counts start again (Unix seconds, midnight UTC).

path.description:
Chain from the owner's root folder down to (and including) the
trashed node, so the client can unwrap its key and show where it was.

TurnstileOptions.description:
Where a Turnstile token is needed. The check runs on `/auth`, a page of
its own; the token then goes with the request as `turnstile`.

register.description: Creating an account (only while registration is open to everyone).

auth.description: The auth key from `derive_link_password_keys`, not the password.

oneOf.description: Re-encrypted metadata (rename).

if_revision.description: Optimistic concurrency: fail with 409 if the node changed.

oneOf.description:
The name tag for the new name or parent. Renaming or moving without
one leaves the node untagged.

parent_id.description:
New parent (move). Requires `enc_key` re-wrapped under the new
parent's key.

daily_download_limit.description: Bytes per day; 0 removes the limit.

UserAvatar.description:
Someone else's picture and display name (either may be missing), for a
user they gave their avatar key to.

oneOf.description: Their ML-KEM-768 key, if they have one: seal to both.

has_thumbnail.description: Whether this version has an encrypted thumbnail (`encrypt_thumbnail`).

VideoInfo.description: What a link points at, and what the downloader would fetch for it.

entries.description: For a playlist link: its videos (and no `video` or `audio`).

qualities.description:
The video at each quality that gives a different result, lowest
first.

oneOf.description:
File extension and approximate size of the video (with sound) and
audio-only downloads, when the site offers them as one file.
Defaults to 1080p.

height.description: Video height in pixels, for video.

oneOf.description: The quality to ask for to get this, for video.

VideoQuality.description:
Highest resolution to fetch. Up to 1080p, H.264 is preferred (it plays
everywhere); `Best` takes the tallest there is, whatever the codec.

linkToken.description: Sent on a public link's requests after `GET /public/{token}` (a link with limited opens) or `/unlock` (a password) handed one out. The link's key and secret never leave the browser; this is a signed pass for this visit.
linkToken.name: X-Link-Token

session.description: The token from signing in (`SessionResponse.token`), or from `/auth/app-login` with an app password. A read-only app password may only GET.

info.description: The HTTP API of a thencloud server, under `/api`. Everything here carries ciphertext, wrapped keys and public keys: names, contents and keys are encrypted and decrypted by the client (`thencloud-crypto`, natively or as WASM), and the formats are in `docs/format/README.md`. Binary fields are unpadded base64url strings. Fields may be added to any object over time; clients should ignore what they don't know.
